key_insight: For incompressible flow, four non-spherical tracers’ orientations and time derivatives can uniquely determine the local velocity gradient tensor when the inversion is nondegenerate.
engineering_relevance: Orientation-based reconstruction could reduce measurement-noise sensitivity and spatial sampling requirements for local flow-gradient diagnostics.
method: Measure nearby rod or flake orientations and their time derivatives.
Invert Jeffery-type dynamics to recover the velocity gradient tensor.
Avoid tracer positions and spatial differencing.
evidence_signal: Numerical tests show more accurate vorticity and comparable strain-rate reconstruction versus position-based estimation; the analysis predicts minimum error scaling as σ^(1/2), versus σ^(1/3).
watch_item: Aligned tracers make the inversion ill-conditioned, causing reconstruction failure in parts of spherical Couette flow.
paper_title: Velocity gradient tensor reconstruction from tracer orientations via Jeffery dynamics
